title: Brews and Bites of Orlando
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Walking distance is approximately 1 mile in total.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Get ready to Wander and Drink around Orlando's Mills50 and Ivanhoe Village districts like a local! Experience 8 beer samples along with some small, delicious bites from multiple locally-run establishments.

Whether you are new to beer or a connoisseur of beer, this tour is for you. This is a chance to get a taste of what Orlando's local breweries offer. 

This pub crawl includes four stops, five locations in total. Learn about the breweries, taste the craft beer they create and possibly get a sneak peek of how it is all done. Along the way, we will grab some small bites to pair with the beer samples.
